assumptions: Steronase left at home — paused 11-25..11-26 (not counted as missed). Omega-3 paused through 11-26.

planned_workout.note: Hotel gym: only light dumbbells + a dual adjustable pulley. Cable swaps for today only; starting weights are guesses — stacks vary, adjust after set 1.

exercises.name: Low-to-High Cable Press
exercises.reasoning: Pulleys at the bottom, press up and in — same upper-chest line as the incline bench.

exercises.name: Standing Cable Chest Press
exercises.reasoning: Pulleys at chest height, staggered stance — mid chest.

exercises.name: Low-to-High Cable Fly
exercises.reasoning: Pulleys low, sweep hands up to chin height — upper-chest fly.

exercises.name: Cable Shoulder Press
exercises.reasoning: No converging machine at the hotel — pulleys at shoulder height, face away, press up and slightly in.

exercises.name: Cable Lateral Raise (single-arm)
exercises.reasoning: Pulley at the bottom, cable crossing behind/in front of the body — constant tension on the side delt.

exercises.name: Overhead Cable Triceps Extension
exercises.reasoning: Rope, pulley low, face away and extend overhead — long head stretch.

exercises.name: Cable Front Raise
exercises.reasoning: Rope between the legs, pulley low.

exercises.name: Cable Crunch
exercises.reasoning: First time — kneeling, rope behind head.
